fields.summary: Parked payments not alerting after retry exhaustion
fields.description: After the 12th failed retry the payment parks correctly but no PagerDuty alert fires. Suspect the alert rule regressed in the retry-scheduler 2.4 release.

comments.author: krunal
comments.body: Confirmed: alert rule filters on status=PARKED but 2.4 renamed the status to RETRY_EXHAUSTED. Fix in progress, see also PAY-990.
